comments.author: @MsTdiniz
comments.text: For all of those who are still in doubt about what the show is about: Well, it's basically a dark comedy, with suspense undertones (because there's a body in the very first scene of the first episode and the audience don't know who is off all the characters), and is especially also a satire of 'white rich people problems', which of course there's almost no problem at all, only superficial and grotesque discussions and complaints and frustrations of basically nothing, while the staff of the hotel is having a complete meltdown. It's probably the most fun and entertainment show to watch this year. Oh yeah, and the cast is amazing!
